messages:
maya: Quick design review please — compact roles summary cards for org settings scroll. Posting fig link + short notes: https://figma.redwood/compact-roles

devin: +1. Love the density but worried about discoverability of SSO confirmation state. The tiny lock icon might be missed.

liz: Agree. Also contrast for the role chips is borderline (BG #f2f4f6 on text #6b7280). We should hit AA for 14px.

sam: For the invite flow, think we should keep an explicit SSO confirmation row under the role selector. Example copy: `This user will sign in with SSO for org.com` — short and clear.

maya: Trying two layouts: (A) inline SSO badge next to name + tooltip, (B) dedicated SSO row under role selector. Thoughts?

devin: Option B is easier for keyboard users — clear focus order. Option A might be better visually but harder to discover for screen readers.

aria: a11y-bot flagged tab order in prototype: Tab lands on chip group before the invite email input. Need: Email -> Role -> SSO confirm -> Invite. Current order: Email -> Chips -> Role.

a11y-bot: Automated check: contrast fails for `role-chip-secondary` at 3.8:1. Suggested fix: darken text to #374151 or use bold.

liz: Copy tweak suggestion for the SSO inline label variants:
```
Variant 1: "SSO required — user will use org SSO"
Variant 2: "SSO enforced for this org"
Variant 3: "Sign-in via org SSO"
```
Preference? I like Variant 3 (short, less modal).

maya: I prefer Variant 1 for clarity ("SSO required"). Could we use `aria-describedby` to point at a hidden detail link? E.g., `aria-describedby=\"sso-help-1\"` that expands on focus.

sam: +1 to aria-describedby. Also propose adding a keyboard-only hint row: `Press ? for keyboard shortcuts` — maybe overkill.

devin: UX nit: roles summary cards collapse into chevrons on narrow widths. The collapse area loses the last-modified timestamp. We should keep a single-line timestamp inside the collapsed header, e.g., `Updated 2d ago` small muted text.

aria: Screen reader flow suggestion: announce role name + permission summary, e.g., "Admin, full project access" then read SSO status. Could wire as: `aria-label=\"Admin role, full access, SSO enforced\"`.

maya: Proposed small copy for collapsed card header: `Admin — full access · Updated 2d ago` (muted). Is that readable enough?

liz: Works. Make sure the dot separator has good spacing and not confusing for assistive tech.

devin: Performance: condensed cards render 40% faster if we avoid nested shadow DOM in each card; eng-platform flagged this earlier. Let's keep DOM flat in compact mode.

maya: Action items so far:
- liz: update role chip color tokens and run contrast checks.
- aria: add aria-describedby to SSO label + share SR announcement text.
- devin/eng: flatten card DOM in compact variant.
- sam: add SSO confirmation row copy + small timestamp in collapsed header.

sam: Quick copy I can iterate on tomorrow. Also thinking about error state microcopy for SSO mismatch: `User's email domain doesn't match org SSO — invite as non-SSO?` Might need legal to ok.

maya: Good call. I'll loop in @legal if we finalize wording. Also, can someone sanity-check the keyboard order in the prototype? (link: https://protos.redwood/compact-roles/kb)

aria: I'll test and post results by EOD.

liz: I'll push color token changes to the design system branch `ds/roles-contrast` and ping once ready.

devin: If we do Option B for SSO, we should make the SSO row collapsible with `aria-expanded` to avoid visual noise for orgs without SSO.

maya: Nice. Let's reconvene Thursday 10am PT for final decisions. Marking this thread as the single source of truth for updates. :calendar:

sam: Thanks all — adding a quick snippet for error toast copy: `\"SSO mismatch — invite sent as standard account\"` (we can A/B test).

aria: A11y quick checklist I'll deliver:
- Tab order fixed
- SR announcement string for collapsed/expanded cards
- ARIA for SSO label + link
- Contrast report for chips

maya: Perfect. End of thread.
